blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Bennie Boatwright has joined Gilas Pilipinas’ preparation for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers in Seremban, Malaysia. A group photo posted by utiltyman Junjun Atienza on his Facebook page, Ginebra Boy’s Ball-Baller’s, showed Boatwright standing in the middle following Sunday’s morning practice. Coach Tim Cone said Boatwright arrived past midnight from China and took part in first practice session.
